steps.label: rich-previous-migration-and-copy
command: import pathlib, runpy, subprocess, sys; source, copied = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:3]); assert source.is_dir() and not copied.exists(); runpy.run_path(sys.argv[3])['closed_copy'](source, copied); print('Copied current specimen without replacing existing data', flush=True); subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'alembic', 'upgrade', 'head'], check=True)

steps.label: rich-current-read-previous
command: import subprocess,sys; subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'alembic', 'upgrade', 'head'], check=True); subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', *sys.argv[1:]], check=True)
